notes: The request body the codex CLI builds for POST {chatgpt_base}/codex/responses. `store` is declared on ResponsesApiRequest WITHOUT a skip_serializing_if attribute, so it is always on the wire, and build_responses_request sets it false on every request; the backend REQUIRES the field to be present and false — a body that omits it is answered 400 {"detail":"Store must be set to false"} (observed live 2026-10-17), which is exactly the defect this fixture pins. The same builder always serializes model, input, tool_choice ("auto"), parallel_tool_calls, store, stream (true), and include; service_tier, tools, stream_options, prompt_cache_key, text and client_metadata carry skip_serializing_if and appear only when set. AMENDMENT 2026-10-17 (observed live): `stream` is REQUIRED too — the backend answers a body that omits it (or sends false) with 400 {"detail":"Stream must be set to true"}. The provider now encodes stream:true unconditionally and serves its non-streaming callers by dispatching the streamed round trip and assembling the canonical events into one response. Input items are the internally tagged ResponseItem shapes (tag "type", snake_case) with role/content, and input text is the ContentItem::InputText shape {type: "input_text", text}. TRANSCRIBED from the codex-rs type definitions rather than read live: the endpoint requires a signed-in ChatGPT account token. The option-typed fields whose exact shapes the referenced definitions did not state in full (reasoning, text, client_metadata, stream_options, service_tier, prompt_cache_key) are deliberately ABSENT rather than guessed, and `tools` is omitted for the same reason (its ResponsesApiTools wrapper shape was not transcribed). PROxyLLM encodes a SUBSET of this body: the contract tests assert `store` (present and false) and `stream`; the rest of the CLI's own context is not proxied.
